svg.title: A profile is a set of services: what a host runs for each device, in one image
svg.text: A profile is a set of services
Each device turns on only the services it needs.
Nothing else runs, so the host stays light.
A host comes in three shapes
Pick the one that fits the box
The full host is the default.
The set of services that device needs
A TV box gets the TV profile and a phone the phone one, unless you choose.
Gold is on, grey is off
Light: a device you only stream and drive. Desktop KPI keeps just the KPI scan.
The stream is full for TV and phone, and lean for the light profiles.
Set it once, the host does the rest
A service no device needs shows idle on the dashboard. That is not a failure.
A real case: one small host, four devices
Nobody read the subtitles. Switching off what nobody reads gives the CPU back.
The three biggest costs: subtitle reading, picture quality filters,
and the extra outputs of each stream.
Switch off only what nobody reads
A box that measures times keeps a full stream, because the KPI scan reads it.
A device whose tests read subtitles keeps the full TV profile.
